LESSON: DANCE

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PERFORMANCE
Topic 8.1: Dance

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Dance. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Perform a free dancing style for enjoyment.
2. dance in pairs and groups for co- operation
3. respond to changes in tempo and rhythms through body movement for enjoyment
4. perform traditional dances within the locality to enhance culture Core-Competence

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Perform a free dancing style for enjoyment.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to perform a free dancing style for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. dance in pairs and groups for co- operation
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to dance in pairs and groups for co- operation. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. respond to changes in tempo and rhythms through body movement for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to respond to changes in tempo and rhythms through body movement for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. perform traditional dances within the locality to enhance culture Core-Competence
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to perform traditional dances within the locality to enhance culture Core-Competence. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Dance.
2. Explain Dance to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

1. Write five sentences about Dance. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Dance important to you?
